Nova already carries fifteen profile columns and six scalars in FluxSurfaceGeometry, validated only against its own analytic fixtures, so this is the first time an outside code checks its conventions - and the same record is the geometry input for training one-dimensional transport equations in the competition entry.

sprints.description: Make the differentiable boundary push the pinned, accelerated core of the spine, then prove the assembled chain — corrected reads, moment seed, accelerated ReconstructProfile, topology labels, CurrentDiffusion flux-ledger consistency — reconstructs MAST equilibria comparably to the firewalled EFIT referee. The parity verdict is the gate the GPU catalog stands on: a catalog of fast wrong equilibria is worthless. Carries the capability recovered from the superseded ambix batched-newton-accelerator plan (exact-tangent NK 62% conversion vs Picard 10/19%; read-wall removals; coupled-KKT profile state) into nova, which owns all physics solves.
sprints.summary: Closed 2026-08-21 at 16/16 plans shipped, 100 percent implementation, empty ready set, no wiring findings. The spine is proven against its references: the Solov'ev closed-form oracle stands with the discrete map exact at the analytic state (4.6e-15 Wb) and the recovery gates locked at round-off floors in a two-tier registered harness (reduced 136-cell always-on fixture, warm-cached carriers slow-lane, all 14 bounds byte-for-value); the faithful moment route, exact Part V kernels and hexagon sections are production defaults. The EFIT flux decomposition delivered both verdicts on the native 65x65 grid across 18 slices: the external field is FIT as a free-boundary boundary condition (fcoil_c cancellation 95.1-98.2 percent under locked convergence-order criteria) and the P4-lower localisation RETRACTS (16/18 residual peaks in the solenoid conductor), reported into the toroidal-harmonics verdict as a measured cross-instrument disagreement. The SOL current demonstration shipped: two converged solutions at exactly identical net current prove finite continuous j from the separatrix to the divertor target on an Eich-scaled closure with zero private-flux current and a machine-precision four-crossing saddle partition. The DINA reference's flux functions were banked by two routes (affine map extraction beside declared profiles_1d, unreconciled; rotation bounded out at 99.77 percent two-function variance explained; the stored map consistent with two-function force balance at 4.78 percent weighted residual). The first forward parity slice proved the prescribed-anchor inputs and wiring sound after a convicted gradient-sign repair, and measured the standard Newton path escaping the plasma basin to the vacuum root - basin reachability, the failure mode dual-basin-solve was commissioned for, so efit-forward-parity relocated to S8 to ride beside that machinery. Feeds S8 (dual-basin-solve via the locked recovery gates; efit-forward-parity; mast-catalog-gpu-solve) and S9/S10 (the forward-transport and DIII-D lanes via flux-function-forward-equilibrium).

The geometry landed this session (44 unique loop positions, join 39 to 43) is kept and migrates to the MAST map; only the wrapper is removed.

S7 executed: 15 worker nodes across 6 waves, all commits merged to main, every session worktree reclaimed. THE SPRINT'S CENTRAL QUESTION IS ANSWERED AND THE ANSWER IS NEGATIVE. The frozen six-shot gate scored end to end for the first time - 45,000 corrected slices, every source index exactly once, 180 atomic partitions, 9,573 slices scored - and returned FAIL on ten of twelve registered metrics with converged_fraction and fixed_point_defect at exactly ZERO. No scored slice on any of the six shots reached the solver's convergence criterion, which subordinates the geometry failures: a position measured on an unconverged flux map is a consequence, not an independent finding. The only two passes are the two metrics that do not require the fixed point to close - the CurrentDiffusion flux ledger at fraction 1 and throughput at 1. Mechanism: the assembled chain reads, seeds, batches, labels and transports correctly, and the GS fit does not converge on real measured magnetics. THE GPU CATALOG (S8) IS EXPLICITLY HELD - the pre-registered meaning of this result under the locked qualified-magnetics bar, whose magnetics allowance never applies because the strict metrics fail on their own. No tolerance was changed, no proxy substituted, and no partition dropped, including through a compute incident that cost 105 of 180 partitions. nova-test-lane-health SHIPPED at 100%: the whole suite now completes in ONE process for the first time in the repository's history - 50 failed, 5655 passed, 141 skipped, 4 xfailed in 2012.90 s, all 5,842 tests - after the starvation owner was named by measurement as retained JAX/XLA CPU compilation (212 of 226 retained threads native-only against 14 Python-managed as the excluding control; 4,221 live executables) and bounded to max 933 of a 1,024 ceiling; the 50 failures then classified 47 regression / 3 pre-existing / 0 suite-order, the 47 traced to one commit adding a required ShotWaveforms field without updating test constructors, and repaired to leave exactly 3. spine-efit-parity and flux-function-forward-equilibrium both stand at 99% with only trigger-deferred work and one active node. Other durable gains: a typed UnsupportedSlice contract that made the 7,500-slice support tally obtainable (4,182 of 7,500 physically supported - more than half a MAST record carries no seedable plasma, which retroactively explains four zero-score attempts as slice selection); the scorecard registry separated into twelve fields so the registered j-phi reproduction and the accelerator fixed-point defect stop being compared as one quantity, with every prior bound byte-identical; the l_i baseline settled as a passive-configuration IMPROVEMENT of 7.688559x rather than a drift, with the asymmetry recorded (passives move l_i by 0.9 pp and I_p by 0.03 pp); and verified reads of the shared machine artifact made concurrency-safe by canonicalizing the four HDF5 superblock consistency-flag bytes, 0/20 to 20/20 trials, narrowness proven against all 2,044 other bytes and published digests unchanged. NOT DONE, with reasons recorded rather than left silent: the pre-registered held-out extension is deliberately unspent because it guards against overfitting a PASS and there is none to generalise; the H200 performance program is deferred on the same logic that holds the catalog; and the convergence failure itself has no owning plan, since spine-boundary-accelerator is shipped and its locking evidence was synthetic self-consistent magnetics - the very case the section-6 measurement identified as the predicted failure mode.

S7 scope corrected on owner direction after a premise error was caught. The frozen-six parity gate was driving ReconstructProfile.least_squares_map through newton_krylov - a whitened least-squares fit to measured magnetics with a hard measured-current equality - so it inferred the flux functions rather than being given them and scored a fitted state against EFIT. That is an inverse solve, outside the forward class nova's own locked matrix assigns it, and its converged_fraction=0 is a fit failing to converge rather than the Grad-Shafranov fixed point failing. The intended demonstration - the free-boundary fixed point given a reference's own flux functions and conductor currents, with no measurement in the path - has never been run. Three plans added to carry it: efit-map-inversion (read the reference correctly), efit-flux-decomposition (validate the external field that is the free-boundary condition), efit-forward-parity (the demonstration itself, replacing the reconstruction gate as the parity claim and inheriting the mast-catalog-gpu-solve block). Evidence already landed from three probe nodes: efm DOES store pprime [time,65] Pa-rad/Wb and ffprime [time,65] T-rad on a 65-point uniform psi_norm, with 397 forward-usable rows exactly matching the usable geometry count, so a forward solve can be driven from stored values; no COCOS is declared in the file, derived digits are compatible with source COCOS 3 with sigma_RphiZ undeterminable. Owner direction to mask the plasma current with the given LCFS is locked as a decision and was decisive - unmasked, 1421 cells closed plasma current at -42.88%; masked to the stored 151-vertex boundary, 938 cells close at -0.0275%, a factor of about 1560, with derived current density correlating 0.999920 against the stored field. The mask also isolates the exterior signal as a measurable diagnostic: -9.605 MA signed and 10.080 MA absolute outside the plasma. The R^4 rotation term is resolved above its own standard error in 11 of 24 bins, so two terms do not suffice everywhere and the physical-versus-numerical separation is its own section.

S7 progress recorded from the plan ledger: the sprint grew from 6 to 14 items through the forward-equilibrium decomposition and 8 are complete at 83.9 percent implementation. Landed by parallel sessions: spine-boundary-accelerator and efit-map-inversion shipped; spine-efit-parity at 99 percent on the corrected read layer; flux-function-forward-equilibrium at 100 percent awaiting closure; plasma-edge-current-representation at 91 percent with a source-moment node live; efit-flux-decomposition at 85 percent.
